title: AcknowledgementPublication
description: Publication of control acknowledgements on topic 'Acknowledgement.<location>.<subtopic>'. <location> is to be replaced by the name of the cyber node at which the acknowledgement is received (the sender of the control once it has reached its destination), <subtopic> by the topic of the control. Acknowledgements of real_time_critical controls are not published (they are returned in the reply to the HMIControl request instead)

control_uid.description: Unique identifier of the acknowledged control (returned in the reply to the HMIControl request)

value.description: Value of the acknowledged control (as received by its destination)

control_time_sent.description: Simulation time at which the control was sent

time_sent.description: Simulation time at which the control reached its destination, and the acknowledgement was sent

time_received.description: Simulation time at which the acknowledgement was received
